history.summary: A 431 sqft freehold shoebox 1BR at Palmera East, a small D14 boutique block (built 2013) just 330m from EW6 Kembangan MRT, at $800k / $1,856 psf. The MRT proximity is excellent, but with only 3 URA transactions there is effectively no reliable appreciation signal, and asking PSF is ~7% above the $1,742 median.
history.rating_rationale: Just 3 URA transactions makes this a data-blind boutique with no meaningful appreciation or liquidity evidence — exactly the thin-data shoebox to skip. Asking $1,856 psf is ~7% above the district median on a 431 sqft format that already lags on growth, in a small block where resale can stall for months. Good MRT distance doesn't offset the premium price + shallow liquidity + unproven track record.
red_flags: Only 3 URA transactions — no reliable appreciation or liquidity read
Tiny boutique block + 431 sqft shoebox — very shallow resale demand
Premium price for an unproven, illiquid unit
catalysts: 330m to Kembangan MRT — strong rental convenience
Freehold, sub-$1M quantum in mature D14 estate
